purpose: Lowtide blue, red and grey container finishes
albedo_handling: Original generated images preserved in Tools; material albedos resampled to 2048x2048 for native power-of-two texture baking, without recolouring.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square seamless PBR BASE COLOUR image for an aged blue shipping container in a British dock game.
Subject: A flat 1.22 metre square patch of industrial painted steel, not the container object. Convincing medium deep dock blue enamel, lightly faded towards desaturated navy-blue. 93 percent still intact paint. Crisp small edge-chipped scrapes exposing charcoal steel and tiny dark orange-brown rust pits, a few thin intersecting scratches, very faint dusty salt streaks and extremely subtle uneven fading. Natural irregular wear of several scales; small patches rather than dense pepper noise. Restrained neutral realism, clear high-frequency detail, a readable confident BLUE paint colour.
Composition: edge-to-edge orthographic texture scan, straight on. Uniform diffuse shadow-free neutral lighting. Truly seamless left/right and top/bottom. No highlights, no directional shading, no vignetting. Opaque square, aim for 2048x2048.
Constraints: This is ONLY albedo for a flat surface. Corrugations will come from a separate normal map: do not draw ribs, bands, metal sheets, seams, joints, bolts or hardware. No lighting gradients, no obvious repeated pattern, no blurry cloud mottling, no giant scratches, no white salt blooms, no large rust areas. No writing, labels, logos, watermark, borders or surrounding scene.
